newsitem.title: USA: Kerr says PBGC seeks to terminate retirement plan.
newsitem.headline: Kerr says PBGC seeks to terminate retirement plan.

text.p: Packaging products maker Kerr Group Inc said on Friday that Pension Benefit Guaranty Corp, which runs its retirement income plan, intended to apply to a U.S. district court for an order terminating the plan.
The application, which PBGC intends to file in Pennsylvania, will seek to establish August 1 as the termination date for the plan, Kerr said in a statement.

Kerr said PBGC took the action to protect its interests in connection with a tender offer for all outstanding shares of common and preferred stock in Kerr. The offer is currently pending and due to expire on August 4, Kerr said.
The tender offer in question, announced in July, is being made by Fremont Partners.
Kerr said discussions between the company, PBGC and Fremont were continuing.
